CI_FAILURE_INVALID.reason: The CI failure input is malformed, is not one failed exact-head required check, or came together with a remote-test receipt.
CI_FAILURE_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: pass one well-formed failed exact-head required CI check and no remote-test receipt.

REMOTE_TEST_RECEIPT_INVALID.reason: The remote-test receipt is not a digest-valid FAIL receipt for this Task, run, executor Task and head.
REMOTE_TEST_RECEIPT_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: obtain a valid EC2 remote-test FAIL receipt for the current head before asking for a repair.

REPAIR_CHAIN_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The continuation chain lock could not be taken, so no count was read and nothing was written.

REPAIR_CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The repair claim list is malformed, the named retry claim is missing, or the claim could not be written.
REPAIR_CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE.pm_action: Reconcile the Task's repair claims and any surfaced unclaimed repair Task, then decide the next step under the repair cap rule.

REPAIR_CODEX_DEVELOPER_RETIRED.reason: The Task's Developer route is Codex, which serves only as Reviewer and AI Debug (#1502 O1).
REPAIR_CODEX_DEVELOPER_RETIRED.pm_action: Replan the repair onto a Developer route that the dispatch file allows.

REPAIR_COUNT_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The repair counts could not be read with certainty, and an unknown count is treated as the limit.
REPAIR_COUNT_UNAVAILABLE.pm_action: Inspect and fix the unreadable Task record in the chain, then decide the next step under the repair cap rule.

REPAIR_DATA_CLASS_INVALID.reason: The gw-agent route takes only SYNTHETIC or PUBLIC_REPO data, and this Task has another data class.
REPAIR_DATA_CLASS_INVALID.pm_action: Replan the repair onto a route permitted for this data class; never change the data class to fit the route.

REPAIR_DEBUG_REQUIRED.reason: A further review repair needs an RCA_CONFIRMED AI Debug of this family on the failed head.
REPAIR_DEBUG_REQUIRED.pm_action: Assign the AI Debug Task under the repair cap rule and decide the repair after its report.

REPAIR_DEVELOPER_BINDING_INVALID.reason: The Task's Developer binding, state, assignment or acceptance list is missing, malformed or too long for a repair.
REPAIR_DEVELOPER_BINDING_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: correct the Task's Developer binding, or replan the work as a new Task.

REPAIR_DEVELOPER_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.reason: The Task's Developer route cannot take a review repair.
REPAIR_DEVELOPER_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.pm_action: Replan the repair onto a supported Developer route that the dispatch file allows.

REPAIR_DISPUTE_OPEN.reason: A review dispute on this PR head is still OPEN, so no review repair starts until it is ruled.

REPAIR_FAILED_FINAL_REQUIRED.reason: A REPLAN Task has used its review route, so it ends FAILED_FINAL instead of taking another repair.
REPAIR_FAILED_FINAL_REQUIRED.pm_action: Record the Task as FAILED_FINAL, which sends the D4 notice, and run no further repair.

REPAIR_FAMILY_INVALID.reason: The repair family name is malformed, ends in -ec2, or is too long.
REPAIR_FAMILY_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: pass a valid base family, or omit it to use pr-<PR>.

REPAIR_HEAD_MOVED.reason: The registered D6 is missing or its head differs from the failed head, so the failure no longer matches the code.
REPAIR_HEAD_MOVED.pm_action: Dispatch a review of the current D6 head or restore its registration; never repair a head that was not reviewed.

REPAIR_LIMIT_REACHED.reason: The repair limit for this failure kind is used up, and an unknown count counts as used.
REPAIR_LIMIT_REACHED.pm_action: Escalate under the repair cap rule: split a ROOT, decide a child, end a REPLAN, or stop a test failure.

REPAIR_LINEAGE_INVALID.reason: The Task lineage kind is not root, child or replan, so the next review step cannot be chosen.
REPAIR_LINEAGE_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the Task's lineage record, then decide the next step under the repair cap rule.

REPAIR_NO_BLOCKING_FINDING.reason: The FAIL verdict has no blocking finding left after dispute rulings, so it is not a valid FAIL.
REPAIR_NO_BLOCKING_FINDING.pm_action: Run no repair; take the next formal review step for this head.

REPAIR_PACKET_INVALID.reason: The repair packet exceeds its size bound.
REPAIR_PACKET_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input that made the packet too large, then decide the repair.

REPAIR_PM_DECIDE_REQUIRED.reason: A child Task has used its review route, so the PM decides the next step instead of another repair.
REPAIR_PM_DECIDE_REQUIRED.pm_action: Decide at PM_DECIDE under existing rules: replan, drop or stop the child Task.

REPAIR_PM_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The Task has no recorded PM session and working directory, so no repair Task can be recorded.
REPAIR_PM_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE.pm_action: Fix the input: record the Task through a PM session, or replan it as a new Task.

REPAIR_POLICY_INVALID.reason: The repair policy file is missing or fails its strict check.
REPAIR_POLICY_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: restore a valid policy.json from main without changing its limits.

REPAIR_ROOT_TASK_REQUIRED.reason: This Task is itself a recorded repair Task, and repairs are claimed only on the root Task.
REPAIR_ROOT_TASK_REQUIRED.pm_action: Fix the input: name the root Task that holds the repair claims.

REPAIR_SPLIT_REQUIRED.reason: A ROOT Task has used its review route, so it splits into child Tasks instead of taking another repair.
REPAIR_SPLIT_REQUIRED.pm_action: Split the ROOT within the child limit, or decide another step under existing rules.

REPAIR_TASK_INVALID.reason: The named Task record is missing or does not match its ID.
REPAIR_TASK_INVALID.pm_action: Fix the input: name an existing Task.

REPAIR_TASK_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The repair continuation Task could not be recorded or validated, so no claim or count was used.
REPAIR_TASK_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.pm_action: Reconcile any surfaced unclaimed repair Task, then decide whether to request the repair again.

REVIEW_FAIL_EVENT_MISSING.reason: No pending Reviewer event with a matching formal FAIL verdict was found for this PR head and version.
REVIEW_FAIL_EVENT_MISSING.pm_action: Confirm the formal verdict and its recorded event, then decide the next review or repair step.

REVIEW_REPAIR_PM_REQUIRED.reason: An automatic review repair stops once the chain holds a review repair claim, or when that is in doubt.
REVIEW_REPAIR_PM_REQUIRED.pm_action: Decide any further repair manually under the repair cap rule; the automatic path does not continue.

REVIEW_RESULT_COMMENTS_INVALID.reason: The PR comments could not be read as a bounded list of comment records.
REVIEW_RESULT_COMMENTS_INVALID.pm_action: Check the PR comment list, then decide the next review step; never repair without a readable verdict.

RUNTIME_NOT_ON_PATH.reason: The claude CLI that this Developer route needs is not on PATH.
